name: Embed and Integrate Etsy Shop
author: Embed360

sections.description:
Etsy Embed (by Embed360) helps Etsy sellers showcase their shop on WordPress without rebuilding inventory from scratch. Shoppers browse listings and product detail pages on your site, then complete checkout on Etsy — you keep your brand experience while Etsy handles payments and fulfillment.

This plugin connects WordPress to your Embed360 account, where two product lines work together:

  • Etsy Embed — Synced shop listings, rich item pages, and Pro widgets (featured listings and shop reviews carousels).
  • Listings Genie — Nova-powered Create and Optimize tools to draft and improve Etsy listings faster (available in your Embed360 dashboard).

Getting started takes minutes: install the plugin, create a free Embed360 account, connect your Etsy shop, and paste your embed token on the Etsy Embed settings page. Step-by-step guides and video walkthroughs are included.

Free plan: embed up to 10 listings at no cost — ideal for trying Etsy Embed before upgrading for more listings and Pro carousels.

See the live demo

Etsy Embed — showcase your shop on WordPress

Shop listings on your WordPress site

Display your Etsy inventory in a clean, theme-friendly layout that helps shoppers compare items and click through for details. Your listings stay in sync with your Etsy shop through Embed360.

Rich item detail pages

Give visitors a true product-page experience on your site: images, variations, quantity, materials, descriptions, and fulfillment information — everything they need to buy with confidence.

Seamless checkout on Etsy

When a shopper is ready to purchase, they are sent to Etsy to complete checkout in the familiar, trusted flow you and your customers already rely on.

Featured listings carousel (Pro)

Showcase your best products in a swipeable carousel that stays synced with your shop and keeps visitors browsing longer. Perfect for highlighting seasonal items, bestsellers, or new arrivals.

Shop reviews carousel (Pro)

Turn social proof into more sales by featuring Etsy reviews on your site with flexible carousel or grid layouts and easy display controls.

Listings Genie — create and optimize listings with Nova

Available in your Embed360 account (open from the plugin welcome screen or at app.embed360.co):

  • Create (Beta) — Turn ideas into polished Etsy drafts in minutes. Start from a simple prompt, refine with Nova, and publish to Etsy Drafts with confidence.
  • Optimize (Beta) — Sharpen titles, tags, and descriptions so the right shoppers find your listings while keeping your brand voice.

Listings Genie runs in Embed360; this plugin links your WordPress site to the same account so Etsy Embed and listing tools stay in one place.

Plans at a glance

  • Free — Up to 10 embedded listings, full item detail pages, and checkout on Etsy.
  • Pro (Etsy Embed) — More listings plus featured listings and shop reviews carousels for your WordPress site.
  • Listings Genie — Create and Optimize tools (Beta) via paid Embed360 plans; manage listings from your Embed360 dashboard.

See Embed360 pricing for current plan details.

What’s New in the plugin

The Etsy Embed admin screen includes a What’s New tab with What’s Coming previews and Recently shipped updates — organized by Etsy Embed and Listings Genie so you can see what’s next for your shop vs your listings. New highlights are also surfaced on the Welcome screen when we ship meaningful updates.

Coming soon: listing videos in the item details image carousel — Etsy listing videos pulled automatically into your product gallery on WordPress.
sections.installation:
1. Visit Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for Embed and Integrate Etsy Shop
  3. Install and activate the plugin
  4. Go to Etsy Embed in the WordPress admin menu
  5. Create your free Embed360 account and connect your Etsy shop
  6. Copy your user token from the Embed Code page and save it in the plugin settings
  7. Follow the WordPress installation guide to add listings to your site
sections.faq:
Who should use this plugin?

Any Etsy seller who wants their shop on WordPress — whether you run a blog, portfolio, or full business site — and prefers shoppers to discover products on your domain before checking out on Etsy.

Is there a free version?

Yes. You can embed up to 10 listings for free. Additional listings, carousels, reviews, and Listings Genie tools are available through paid Embed360 plans.

Do I need an Embed360 account?

Yes. An Embed360 account connects the plugin to your Etsy shop, serves your embed code, and unlocks features like Listings Genie and Pro embed widgets.

Does checkout happen on my WordPress site?

No. Purchases are completed on Etsy. The plugin is designed to showcase your products on WordPress and hand off checkout to Etsy securely.

Where can I get help?

Visit Embed360 Help Center or the installation article for WordPress.
